headline: Sensex and Nifty extend gains for third straight week as FII buying fuels market comeback

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 16 November.

why: Foreign Institutional Investor (FII) buying supported Indian benchmarks to extend weekly gains.
Smallcap indices jumped 3.6% and PSU banks surged 7.5%, boosting broad market sentiment.
An AI stock retreat in global markets fueled a rotation trade into Indian equities.
Inflation concerns and mixed global signals created brief pullbacks during recent sessions.
whatHappening: Indian equity benchmarks closed higher for the third consecutive week despite global Nvidia stress.
Sensex registered a sharp surge during mid-week sessions, adding Rs 4.5 lakh crore in investor wealth.
Pollution-linked health insurance claims spiked 4.3x in three years, led by Delhi.
Bitcoin tumbled to a four-month low amid mass liquidations of leveraged crypto positions.
summary: Indian benchmark indices finished higher for the third straight week, driven by strong FII inflows, PSU bank rallies, and smallcap gains. A rotation trade away from global tech retreat provided support to domestic equities. The market is closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 16 November.
